subject: Request: latest penetration test report for Hosted API + secure transfer options
messages:
From: Tom Hanley <tom.hanley@acme-corp.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API and delivery options

Hi Jasmine,

We are completing our SOC 2 evidence pack and need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's Hosted API (api.redwood.ai). Can you confirm the latest report version and whether you can share a redacted PDF plus the evidence manifest?

Also please advise on secure delivery options your team supports (we typically prefer a short-lived S3 URL or a secure portal). If you require an NDA or a data room ticket to provide anything more than a redacted report, let me know.

Two quick clarifications: 1) confirm the scope covered by the report (gateway, inference runtime, console, auth), and 2) whether the report includes remediation status / ticket references.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Hanley
Security Operations
Acme Corp

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hanley <tom.hanley@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API and delivery options

Tom, thanks for the note — happy to help.

Quick answers up front:
- Latest report: redwood_pt_summary_v4_redacted.pdf (we will provide a redacted summary by default).
- Evidence manifest: we can include a CSV manifest mapping findings -> remediation tickets; we will avoid attaching raw logs without an NDA.
- Delivery: we can place materials in our Secure Evidence Exchange (SEE) portal (short-lived user link + OTP) or provide an encrypted bundle on S3 wrapped with KMS and ephemeral credentials. We can also work with your preferred vendor if you need a specific transfer mechanism.

A couple of asks before we share:
1) Please confirm that the scope you need is limited to Hosted API (not Dedicated or Private deployments).
2) Confirm the individual(s) who will download the materials and whether Acme requires an additional NDA or a non-disclosure addendum.

I’ve looped in Marcus (security) for remediation details and Laura (legal) for any contractual items. If you'd like, we can schedule a short sync to walk through the report and remediation plan.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hanley <tom.hanley@acme-corp.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API and delivery options

Hi Tom — quick technical summary and remediation status from the security team.

Scope confirmed for the December 2026 engagement:
- In-scope: Hosted API endpoint (api.redwood.ai) including the public gateway, inference runtime instances in the hosted fleet, account management/auth endpoints in the Console, and our model storage/serving layer.
- Out-of-scope: Dedicated pools and Private (VPC) deployments; those are tested separately under customer engagements.

What we will provide:
- redwood_pt_summary_v4_redacted.pdf: high-level findings and reproducing steps removed where they could divulge sensitive exploit details.
- redwood_pt_evidence_manifest_v4.csv: per-finding metadata (finding id, severity, status, remediation ticket id, fix date).
- remediation_ticket_list_2026-12-02.csv: exported ticket ids and short descriptions for all fixes referenced in the manifest.

Remediation highlights (selected):
- FIND-2026-043: Missing validation on model-upload metadata — fixed (patch deployed 2026-11-18) — ticket RL-2317 (closed).
- FIND-2026-051: Excessive token lifetime for internal service account — rotated keys and reduced TTL (2026-11-25) — ticket RL-2362 (closed).
- FIND-2026-059: Rate-limiting bypass under a crafted header sequence — mitigation deployed as WAF rule (2026-11-30) — ticket RL-2398 (in verification).

Notes on what we do not provide without additional controls: raw memory dumps, full exploit PoC, and customer-submitted payload examples. For that evidence we require a DPA addendum and approved access request.

Preferred delivery path: SEE portal (recommended) — generates an audit trail, OTP for download, and a 72-hour expiration. Alternative: KMS-wrapped S3 object with IAM role that issues ephemeral creds for a 48-hour window. Let us know which you prefer.

If you want a walk-through I can join a 30-minute session and point to the fixes and mitigations.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@acme-corp.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Hanley <tom.hanley@acme-corp.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-12-02T11:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API and delivery options

Thanks Jasmine and Marcus — this looks good. Confirming Acme only needs the Hosted API scope. We prefer the SEE portal option for the audit trail; please provision access for two people: myself (alice.monroe@acme-corp.com) and Tom (tom.hanley@acme-corp.com).

A couple of additional asks: 
- Can you include the remediation_ticket_list_2026-12-02.csv and the evidence manifest?
- For our SOC 2 folder we will store the redacted PDF. If you can add short remediation notes next to each ticket ID in the CSV, that would help.
- We do not require raw exploit PoCs, but may request temporary access later if the auditor asks — we understand there will be an approval flow.

Let me know when the portal link is available. If you need our signed PDF NDA, send it over (we can countersign quickly).

Best,
Alice Monroe
Senior InfoSec Manager
Acme Corp

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: alice.monroe@acme-corp.com, tom.hanley@acme-corp.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-02T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: latest pen test report for Hosted API and delivery options — materials available in SEE portal

Alice/Tom — thanks, we’ve prepared the set and provisioned access. Delivery details below: 

Delivery method: Secure Evidence Exchange (SEE) portal (one-time OTP + audit log)
Portal access: https://see.redwood.ai/share/ACME-2026-12-02 (link expires 72 hours after first access)
OTP: will be emailed separately to the two addresses you provided.

Included artifacts (attached to the portal bundle and mirrored here):
- redwood_pt_summary_v4_redacted.pdf (redacted report)
- redwood_pt_evidence_manifest_v4.csv (finding id, severity, remediation ticket id, short remediation note)
- remediation_ticket_list_2026-12-02.csv (exported ticket ids and statuses)

Notes:
- The manifest includes short remediation notes next to ticket ids, per your request.
- Raw artifacts (memory dumps, PoCs) were excluded and will require a DPA addendum + formal access request; contact laura_bennett@redwood.ai for the request path.
- Audit trail entry and download receipts will be available in the portal for your records.

If you want us to upload a copy to a shared Box folder instead, we can do that as well (Box links require SSO).

Next steps:
1) Confirm receipt of the OTP email and that you can access the portal link.
2) Let us know if you need a 30-minute walkthrough; Marcus and I are available tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0118

Attachments: redwood_pt_summary_v4_redacted.pdf; redwood_pt_evidence_manifest_v4.csv; remediation_ticket_list_2026-12-02.csv
